description: Model-layer availability of forecast predictors. 'evidence': dated by archived release vintages in the store (public as-of). 'rule': ASSUMPTION, no archived release dates exist; a period counts as public lag_days after its period end (end of that Berlin day). Rules are never written to the store; results are reported with and without rule-dated predictors. in_forecast marks the inputs of the published model (chosen 2026-10-20 on both backtests).

orders.label: Residential order intake, main construction industry, volume index (unadjusted)

materials.label: Producer prices of construction materials: mean of wood, rubber/plastics, glass/ceramics/stone, metals, metal products (2021=100)
materials.basis: Bundesbank real-time PP1/PP100 vintages date every 61241 index (one Destatis release; registry BUNDESBANK_RTD industrial_producer_price_release_calendar).

energy.label: Producer prices of energy supply (electricity, gas, heat)
energy.basis: Bundesbank real-time PP1/PP100 vintages (same Destatis release as all 61241 indices).

price_expectations.label: Builders' price expectations, next 3 months (EU business survey, balance)
price_expectations.basis: European Commission business surveys are published at the end of the reference month (Eurostat dataset updated 2026-09-29 including September 2026); unadjusted balances are not revised.

material_shortage.label: Builders held back by material shortages (% of firms)
material_shortage.basis: Same survey and timing as price_expectations.

permits.label: Building permits, new residential buildings, dwellings
permits.basis: Destatis permits release about 48 days after month end (August 2025: PD25_378 on 17.10.2025; June 2025: PD25_302 in August 2025). 60 days adds a margin for older, slower releases.

wages.label: Negotiated monthly earnings excl. special payments, construction
wages.basis: Destatis Fachserie 16 Reihe 4.3: quarterly results as a rule at the latest 60 calendar days after the reference period; 75 days adds a margin.

material_cost.label: Construction cost index for residential buildings, material
material_cost.basis: No official release calendar found. At the 2026-10-19 fetch 2026-Q2 was present and 2026-Q3 absent although the Q3 price index was released 2026-10-09, so the lag is between 19 and 110 days; 120 days is the conservative bound.

labour_cost.label: Construction cost index for residential buildings, labour
labour_cost.basis: Same table and evidence as material_cost; the labour component uses the quarterly construction labour cost index.

mortgage_rate.label: German bank lending rate for house purchase, new business
mortgage_rate.basis: ECB bank interest rate statistics release: August 2025 data on 1 October 2025 (31 days); 45 days adds a margin.
